cards.acceptance:
test -f src/a.ts
echo '== full'; node_modules/.bin/vitest related --run src/a.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=dot

vitest.red:
#!/bin/sh
echo "$*" >> vitest.args
echo " FAIL  tests/a.test.ts > A example 1: red"
echo " FAIL  tests/a.test.ts > A example 1: red"
echo " FAIL  tests/c.test.ts [ tests/c.test.ts ]"
echo " Test Files  2 failed (2)"
exit 1
vitest.green:
#!/bin/sh
echo "$*" >> vitest.args
echo " Test Files  3 passed (3)"
exit 0
vitest.broken:
#!/bin/sh
echo "$*" >> vitest.args
echo "Error: [vitest-worker]: Timeout calling onTaskUpdate"
echo " Tests  3 passed (3)"
exit 1
vitest.runRed:
#!/bin/sh
[ "$1" = related ] && exit 0
echo " FAIL  tests/a.test.ts > A example 1: red"
exit 1
